label: August 31 – September 6, 2026
intro: First weekend of September — school rhythm settling in, making it the perfect time to lock in hands-on workshops, quiet rink sessions, and a science day before life gets busy again.
weekday_note: Weekday afternoons are gold for uncrowded rinks and museums while school groups haven't arrived yet.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic Workshop
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios — Thonglor / central BKK area
activities.price: ~500–900 THB per person — check classbento.co.th for current pricing
activities.why: Thor loves making things with his hands — pottery lets him pinch, roll, and sculpt his own creation to take home after firing. Perfect hands-on builder activity.
activities.tip: Book 3–5 days ahead — weekend morning sessions fill quickly. Check the studio Instagram for kids-only sessions.

activities.title: Bean to Bar Chocolate Workshop
activities.date: Saturday or Sunday September 5–6 — book via Klook or Tripadvisor
activities.location: Bangkok central — check Klook or Tripadvisor for exact venue
activities.why: Thor loved making chocolate before — Bean to Bar shows the full journey from cacao bean to finished bar: mixing, moulding, tasting. He goes home with something he made himself.
activities.tip: Book well in advance. If weekend slots are full, weekday sessions are quieter and the same experience.

activities.title: Chatuchak Weekend Market
activities.time: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (go early — hottest and most crowded after noon)
activities.location: Chatuchak (JJ Market), MRT Chatuchak Park / BTS Mo Chit (N8)
activities.price: Free entry — budget for food and any small finds
activities.why: 15,000+ stalls, a kids toy section, and street food Thor will love: coconut ice cream in a shell, mango sticky rice, grilled pork skewers. Right next to Children's Discovery Museum — easy double-header day.
activities.tip: Arrive at 9 AM, food first (Sections 2–6), then toys. JJ Mall next door has aircon for a midday break. Combine with Children's Discovery Museum in Queen Sirikit Park across the road.

activities.title: Neilson Hays Library Storytime
activities.location: Neilson Hays Library, 195 Surawong Rd, Bangrak (BTS Chong Nonsi)
activities.price: Small day-visitor or membership fee — check neilsonhayslibrary.com
activities.why: Themed stories and hands-on craft activity every Saturday. Calm, creative morning start before a bigger afternoon adventure.
activities.tip: Runs every Saturday at 10:30 AM year-round. Book a Chatuchak trip or workshop for the afternoon to make a full day of it.

activities.title: TIIHA Olympic Ice Rink — Beginner Sessions
activities.time: Check tiiha.com for current public session hours
activities.location: TIIHA, Rama 9 Soi 19, Bangkapi, Huaikwang (MRT Phra Ram 9)
activities.price: Check tiiha.com for current pricing; skate rental available on-site
activities.why: Full Olympic-sized ice surface (60m x 30m) — far more space than mall rinks. Weekday afternoon sessions are quiet, giving Thor room to build confidence. Development club for structured beginner lessons.
activities.tip: Weekday afternoons are least crowded. Ask about development club enrollment while there if Thor wants proper lessons.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum — Chatuchak
activities.location: Children's Discovery Museum, Queen Sirikit Park, Chatuchak (BTS Mo Chit / MRT Chatuchak Park)
activities.price: Free for children; small adult admission
activities.why: Thailand's first children's museum. Creative Science Zone has experiments Thor runs himself. Dinosaur Detective Zone lets him dig for bones. Right next to Chatuchak Market — easy same-day combo.
activities.tip: Tuesday–Thursday mornings are quietest. Dinosaur bone-digging is a consistent 5-year-old hit. Closed Mondays.

activities.title: Bangkok Science Center & Planetarium
activities.time: Tuesday–Sunday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; English planetarium show Tuesdays 10:00 AM
activities.location: Science Center for Education & Bangkok Planetarium, 928 Sukhumvit Rd (BTS Ekkamai — 2 min walk)
activities.price: ~50–100 THB entry; small additional fee for planetarium show
activities.why: Four buildings of hands-on science. The dome planetarium show is mind-expanding for a 5-year-old — stars and space projected all around you. Robot and human body exhibits are all interactive.
activities.tip: Tuesday morning: English planetarium show at 10 AM, then Science Museum building after. Easy 2–3 hours here. BTS Ekkamai is at the entrance.
